slots.name: meeting date
slots.sentence: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell met with Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker and the leadership of the state’s General Assembly on Thursday, adding another wrinkle to the Chicago Bears’ long-running pursuit of a new home.
